messages:
emma: heads-up deploy-bot paused promotion for release v2.5.0 — artifact index flip: registry returned 200 but index points to old digest, smoke 1/3 infra timeout. https://ci.redwood.example/runs/120987

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: reason=index_digest_mismatch, artifact=api@sha256:beefcafe, expected_digest=sha256:beefcafe, index_digest=sha256:beefbabe, auto_retries=1

emma: logs:
```
ERROR index: digest mismatch for key artifacts/api/sha256:beefcafe -> index shows sha256:beefbabe
WARN smoke: ephemeral-mongo failed to allocate port (EADDRINUSE)
```

rafael: This reads like registry write succeeded but index update rolled back on reindex. Mirror/cron might have written older pointer.

devops-lead: change window closes in 12m. options: 1) short wait + retry, 2) manual promote last-known-good, 3) rerun build (long). thoughts?

emma: last-good is api@sha256:ab12cd34 promoted 3h ago. No active fixes pending. I'm +1 manual promote to keep window.

ci-bot: Quick check: unit/integration green on last-good, e2e smoketest pass rate 97% historically.

ops-oncall: agree with manual promote. create follow-up ticket to audit index writer and add guard for mismatched index digest on promote.

devops-lead: ok i'll run promote with annotation. `deployctl promote --artifact api@sha256:ab12cd34 --target=stable --reason "index digest mismatch; avoid missing change window"`

deploy-bot: Promotion executed by devops-lead. stable -> api@sha256:ab12cd34. Note added to release metadata.

emma: window unblocked. filing TKT-7701 to investigate index writer race and to add early fail for digest mismatch. thanks all.

rafael: follow-up: if CI rerun for beefcafe passes and index reconciles, we can consider re-promote in a later window.

emma: closing thread — will update release notes with the pin note and TKT link. :rocket:
